purpose: Design for checking formal references against actual files, listing reverse references and change-impact candidates, notifying them, and running consistency checks.
summary: Formal references are extracted from reference-link definitions whose title ends with a DLID, with an optional recorded content hash
Real directory scan classifies targets as match, path mismatch, or absent, and checks fragments and anchors
Path-mismatch fix targets are notified only when the same ID is uniquely confirmed by the scan
Links without a DLID in the title get a suggested value of content hash plus DLID read from current files
Reverse references are built from scanned sources and limited to documents and sections in the confirmed ToC
Recorded hash in a title is compared exactly with the target current hash to list impact candidates
Indirect referrers are not listed; impact propagates one step at a time
Notification is stateless; the same reference is returned until the project management AI rewrites the recorded hash
Consistency checks are split into check-dlid, check-links, check-toc and check-impact and never modify managed state
tasks: Designing or implementing check-links reference validation
Handling path mismatch and fragment mismatch diagnostics
Writing title values for links without a DLID
Writing tests for reference and impact checks
